facts.text: Jolene completed a difficult engineering project and finished it last month.

evidence.quote: I finally wrapped that up last month.
You really put in the work and it paid off.

facts.text: Jolene is currently interning at a well-known engineering firm and has been applying her academic knowledge to real projects.

evidence.quote: I'm interning at a well-known engineering firm. It's been a great opportunity to test my skills and gain real-world experience.
The best part so far has been being able to apply what I learned in school to real projects.

facts.text: Jolene expressed pride in completing the project and is confident in her ability to handle challenges.

evidence.quote: I'm really proud of myself for sticking it out despite the problems and finishing it.
